scene_analysis.scene_overview: A street view of a city street with tall buildings on both sides, lined with parked motorcycles and outdoor seating areas for restaurants and cafes. The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings indicating pedestrian crossings and bike lanes. There are several trees planted along the sidewalk, some of which have lost their leaves. The sky is clear and blue.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are multi-story structures with balconies and windows. They appear to be residential or commercial properties. Some have awnings over their entrances.
scene_analysis.materials: The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings indicating pedestrian crossings and bike lanes. There are also concrete planters filled with plants and shrubs along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables outside the restaurants and cafes. Some have umbrellas to provide shade.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are mostly bare, suggesting it may be winter or early spring. There are also some evergreen plants in planters along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs visible, including street signs and directional signs. Some of them are illegible.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street is quiet, with only a few people visible. There are some shops and cafes with outdoor seating.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The street is a popular spot for shopping and dining.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The street is a great spot for taking photos and exploring the surrounding neighborhood.
scene_analysis.as_student: The street is a great place to study urban development and sustainability.
